contract.derivation: Props are the component's own destructured parameters; defaults are its source text; declared values come from the variant manifest.
contract.documentation: A description comes from JSDoc (@param props.name / @prop) or the trailing // comment beside the prop.

Alert.summary: Inline notice inside a page or a form — a banner that stays until the reader deals with it. Transient feedback is `Toast`, not this.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Renders the dismiss button. Without it the notice cannot be closed.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline; omit for a one-line notice.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour and icon; carries the meaning, so it is never decorative.

AttachmentRow.summary: One file on a task: its type glyph, name, size, and the actions available for it.

props.name: isArchived
props.description: Read-only history: nothing may be deleted.

props.name: isEditing
props.description: The description is open for editing, so inserting a link is possible.

props.name: onInsert
props.description: Inserts a markdown link to it into the description.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Opens the file in the viewer.

AttachmentViewer.summary: Full-screen viewer for one attachment — image, PDF, or the download card for anything the browser cannot render.

props.name: attachment
props.description: The file to show; `null` closes the viewer.

AttributeTrigger.summary: The strip's own overflow control — «Деталі», the button that opens the less-frequently-changed fields.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether the drawer is open; this is the pressed look.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Scrolled state, matching the strip above it.

AvatarButton.summary: An avatar that is a control: opens a profile, or anchors a popover.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — a face names nobody to a screen reader.

props.name: size
props.description: Named token from the avatar scale, shared with `UserAvatar`.

Breadcrumb.summary: The trail on the left of the workspace header, optionally with the search that expands over it.

props.name: isSearchActive
props.description: Whether the search has replaced the trail.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail, root first; the last entry is the current page.

props.name: showSearchButton
props.description: Whether the trail offers a search toggle at all.

Button.summary: The kit's button. Its height, line box and radius come from `.ui-control` in `globals.

props.name: buttonRef
props.description: Ref to the underlying button, for popovers anchored to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Placement in the parent only — never its own height, padding or type.

props.name: collapseAt
props.description: Viewport width below which the label is hidden and only the icon remains.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Unavailable: dimmed, not clickable, still readable.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading lucide icon. Its pixel size is derived from `size`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks the click.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height token; the icon sizes are square boxes.

props.name: style
props.description: Weight of the button in its context.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which background the button sits on, where that changes its contrast.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy alias for `style`, kept for existing call sites.

Card.summary: A bounded block of content. `Card` is `Surface` with the four presets a card can take; reach for `Surface` when the block is a region of a page rather than an object in a list.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds the pointer, hover tint and focus ring. Set it whenever `onClick` is set.

props.name: preset
props.description: Which surface it draws. Wins over `variant`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy shorthand kept for existing call sites; `gray` means `preset="canvas"`.

ChannelInfoPanel.summary: The panel beside a conversation: its description, its members, and everything ever attached to it, on three tabs.

props.name: isAdminOrOwner
props.description: Whether the reader may change membership or the description.

props.name: messages
props.description: Its messages, which the attachments tab reads.

props.name: onJumpToMessage
props.description: Scrolls the conversation to that message.

props.name: onOpenAttachment
props.description: Opens an attachment in the viewer.

ChannelRail.summary: The chat rail: grouped channels and direct messages, with unread counters.

ChatAttachmentList.summary: The files attached to a sent message, as a grid of tiles.

props.name: compact
props.description: Denser tiles, for threads and narrow panes.

props.name: dark
props.description: Inverted tiles, for a message bubble on a dark surface.

ChatComposerCore.summary: The message input itself, shared by all three chats — workspace, timeline and QuickTeam+.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Pending attachments, drawn above the field.

props.name: canSubmit
props.description: Whether sending is currently allowed at all.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Unavailable: the field and the send button are both blocked.

props.name: leading
props.description: Controls before the field — the attach button.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key handler; this is where mention navigation hooks in.

props.name: rows
props.description: Initial visible rows before it grows.

props.name: sendAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the icon-only send button.

props.name: sending
props.description: In flight: the send button shows the wait.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Visible label on the send button, where it has one.

props.name: textareaRef
props.description: Ref to the textarea, for mention menus and focus handling.

props.name: textareaStyle
props.description: Inline style for the textarea, for measured heights.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which chat this is; changes the frame, not the behaviour.

ChatComposerDock.summary: The floating shelf the chat composer sits on.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as; `form` where the composer submits.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: The scroller to pad. Without it only the CSS variable is published.

ChatConversationHeader.summary: The bar above a conversation: who or what it is, what is pinned, the info toggle, and the way back out on a phone.

props.name: infoActive
props.description: Whether the info panel is open — this is the pressed look.

props.name: infoLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the info toggle.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Returns to the rail at mobile width.

props.name: online
props.description: Whether they are present right now.

props.name: pinnedCount
props.description: How many messages are pinned; zero hides the control.

props.name: statusEmoji
props.description: The person's status emoji, for a direct message.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under it — member count, or the person's role.

props.name: title
props.description: Channel name, or the other person's name.

props.name: type
props.description: A channel gets a hash, a direct message gets a face.

props.name: user
props.description: The other person, for the avatar.

ChatMessageList.summary: The scrolling conversation: day separators, avatar grouping, the unread divider, the jump-to-latest button and paging into history.

props.name: endRef
props.description: Anchor at the bottom, for scroll-to-latest.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: There is older history to page into.

props.name: loading
props.description: The first page is still arriving.

props.name: myUid
props.description: The signed-in user, which decides which side a bubble sits on.

props.name: onOpenAttachment
props.description: Opens an attachment in the viewer.

props.name: registerMessageRef
props.description: Records each message's node, for jumping to a search hit.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: The scroller, shared with the composer dock.

props.name: searchTerm
props.description: Current query; matches are highlighted in place.

props.name: unreadCount
props.description: How many unread messages sit below the fold.

ChatSearchBanner.summary: The amber strip above a filtered conversation: how many messages matched, and the way to drop the filter.

props.name: count
props.description: How many messages matched; the wording declines with it.

props.name: id
props.description: Id for the native input; generated when omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the box; clicking it toggles.

ConfirmProvider.summary: Hosts the one confirm dialog the app uses, and hands `useConfirm()` to everything under it — a promise-returning replacement for native `confirm()`/`prompt()`.

ContextMenu.summary: The dropdown menu behind a ⋮ or any other trigger. Rendered in a portal, so a row with `overflow: hidden` cannot cut it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Placement of the trigger wrapper only.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether a click closes it; toggle menus keep it open while ticking.

props.name: items
props.type: {label: string, icon?, onClick?, isDivider?: boolean, isDanger?: boolean, color?: string, selected?: boolean}[]
props.description: The rows; `selected` gives one a trailing tick instead of a "✓ " in its label.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the menu.

Counter.summary: The number on a bell, a tab or a rail item — and, as `variant="dot"`, the same signal with the number left out.

props.name: dark
props.description: High-contrast variant for the dark sidebar.

props.name: size
props.description: `xs` (12px) is the one that fits on a bell icon; `sm` overflows there.

props.name: status
props.description: Meaning, not decoration: `info` is neutral and takes the surface's opposite.

props.name: value
props.description: Printed for `variant="count"`; ignored by the dot.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the badge carries a number or only says "there is something here".

DatePicker.summary: A date field with the kit's own calendar in a portal — not the native one, because a range needs two dates and the platform control cannot express that.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Drops the calendar glyph where the context already says "date".

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Placement of the inner trigger only.

props.name: mode
props.description: One date, or a start and an end.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the new date in `single` mode.

props.name: onDateRangeChange
props.description: Fires with the new range in `range` mode.

props.name: textTone
props.description: Colour role for the trigger's text.

props.name: yearRange
props.description: Years offered in the year dropdown.

DescriptionPlaceholder.summary: What a task shows where its description would be: a line of italic hint text that is also the button which starts editing.

Dialog.summary: The kit's modal. Every dialog in the product is this component — the shell, the overlay, the focus trap and the escape key all live here, so no screen builds its own.

props.name: headerAction
props.description: A control in the top-right, beside the close button.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether it is on screen. The dialog renders nothing when false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Closes it: the ×, the overlay and Escape all call this.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Centred dialog, or a sheet from the edge.

EmptyState.summary: What a list shows when it has nothing in it: a glyph, a sentence, and the action that would fill it.

props.name: action
props.description: Label of the primary button; without it no button is drawn.

props.name: context
props.description: How much of the screen the empty area owns.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence saying why, or what to do.

props.name: icon
props.description: lucide glyph in the round chip.

props.name: surface
props.description: Whether it draws its own card behind the text.

props.name: title
props.description: One line saying what is missing.

FileInput.summary: The invisible half of "attach a file": a hidden native input that a real button clicks through a ref. Everything else — `accept`, `multiple`, `onChange` — reaches the native input.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the hidden input; it stays hidden regardless.

FilterBar.summary: The row of filters under a page header.

props.name: context
props.description: Width scale: a list page, or a detail pane.

FormGroup.summary: One field: caption above, control inside, error message below.

props.name: error
props.description: Message under the control. Falsy prints nothing.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between caption, control and message.

props.name: required
props.description: Prints the required hint on the caption.

HeaderSearch.summary: The search field inside the workspace header. Reached through `TopHeader`, which is the only thing that renders it — it is not a general search input.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Clears the field; renders the × while there is text.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fill and hover treatment; the dark ones exist for overlays and dark surfaces.

props.name: buttonRef
props.description: Ref to the underlying button, for popovers anchored to it.

props.name: icon
props.description: lucide icon; its pixel size comes from `size`, never from the call site.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip. Required — an icon alone names nothing.

props.name: size
props.description: Box size, mapped onto Button's icon sizes.

ImageUpload.summary: Picks an image, uploads it, and shows what is currently set — the workspace logo and the project avatar both go through here.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the uploaded image's URL.

props.name: onError
props.description: Fires when the upload fails, with a message to show.

props.name: showHint
props.description: Whether the size and format hint is drawn.

props.name: theme
props.description: Which surface it sits on; onboarding is dark, settings is light.

props.name: value
props.description: URL of the image already stored.

InnerNavigation.summary: The vertical menu inside a `SidebarLayout` rail — settings sections, team views. Page-level navigation is the workspace sidebar; this is navigation within one page.

props.name: items
props.type: {id: string, label: string, icon?: React.ComponentType, count?: number}[]

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected id.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: error
props.description: Draws the error border; a string is not printed here, `FormGroup` prints it.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading lucide icon inside the field.

props.name: preset
props.description: A named field role that changes alignment and figures.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height token, shared with Button and Select.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short trailing unit (`₴/г`, `%`) drawn inside the control, with room reserved from its length.

IssueLinkRow.summary: One relation between two tasks — «блокує», «дублює» — with the linked task beside it. The row owns its geometry because the hit area of the remove button is part of it.

props.name: canRemove
props.description: Whether the reader may break this link.

props.name: label
props.description: The relation type, printed as the leading badge.

props.name: requiresReview
props.description: The link came from an import and nobody has confirmed it yet.

KpiCard.summary: One number on an analytics screen: the figure, what it counts, and how it moved.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph in the grey chip. The chip is never themable — see below.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the card a control, with the hover ring that goes with it.

props.name: sub
props.description: Smaller line under the label — the period, usually.

props.name: trend
props.description: Percent change; sign decides the arrow and the colour.

Label.summary: The caption above a field. Usually reached through `FormGroup`; used directly where a control needs a caption without a field wrapper.

props.name: context
props.description: Type scale: above a field, or beside one.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Id of the control this labels.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph, sized by the kit — passing one through `children` breaks the line box.

props.name: required
props.description: Prints the required hint on the right.

LoadingSpinner.summary: The kit's only spinner. Use it where the wait has no shape yet; where the shape is known, an `EmptyState` or skeleton row says more.

props.name: label
props.description: Text under the ring; also what a screen reader announces.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter and stroke, from one scale.

MarkdownEditor.summary: The description editor: a markdown textarea with a formatting toolbar, its own undo history, a preview tab and file upload.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: CSS height the writing area starts at.

props.name: onUploadFiles
props.description: Uploads dropped or picked files and returns their URLs.

props.name: uploading
props.description: Busy: the toolbar's upload action is blocked while a file is in flight.

MarkdownViewer.summary: Renders the markdown a `MarkdownEditor` produced, with the kit's type scale applied to every element.

props.name: onTaskToggle
props.description: Fires with the rewritten source when a task checkbox is ticked.

props.name: size
props.description: Type scale for the rendered body.

MemberRail.summary: The team rail: a titled, counted list of people, with presence.

props.name: action
props.description: Control beside the heading — search, or invite.

props.name: loading
props.description: The list is still arriving; a spinner takes its place.

MentionMenu.summary: The list that opens over a composer when you type `@`. It draws and highlights; the keyboard belongs to the composer, which owns `selectedIndex`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and whether the email is shown.

props.name: members
props.description: Candidates, already filtered by what was typed.

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Which row the arrow keys have landed on; -1 for none.

MessageBubble.summary: One message: the author header when it starts a run, the text, its attachments, its reactions, and the actions that appear on hover.

props.name: isThread
props.description: Inside a thread pane: no thread action, tighter layout.

props.name: myUid
props.description: The signed-in user, which decides which side the bubble sits on and what may be edited.

props.name: onOpenAttachment
props.description: Opens an attachment in the viewer.

props.name: prevMsg
props.description: The one above it; consecutive messages from the same author share one avatar header.

props.name: searchTerm
props.description: Current query; matches are highlighted in the text.

MetaTrigger.summary: A label, a face and a name in one row that opens a popover — «Автор: ⬤ Артур». It sits in the metadata strip under a title.

props.name: name
props.description: Displayed name; falls back to the user's own.

MultiSelect.summary: `Select` that keeps several values at once, with a search box and a select-all row once the list is long enough to need them.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label sits above.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Unavailable: the trigger is dimmed and will not open.

props.name: filterContext
props.description: Which width scale that lookup uses.

props.name: filterRole
props.description: Which filter this is; `FilterBar` decides the width from it.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content pinned under the list — a hint, or a create action.

props.name: options
props.type: {value: string, label: string, icon?, color?, user?}[]

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text while nothing is selected.

props.name: showSelectedAvatars
props.description: Draws the chosen people as a stack of faces on the trigger.

props.name: variant
props.description: How much chrome the trigger draws.

PageHeader.summary: The block at the top of a screen: title, tabs, filters and actions, in the one arrangement every page uses.

props.name: mobileActions
props.description: What replaces them at mobile width.

PendingChatAttachments.summary: The same grid, before the message is sent: local files that can still be removed.

props.name: files
props.description: Files picked but not yet uploaded.

props.name: color
props.description: Arbitrary hex, for user-chosen colours (labels, statuses) that no token can name.

props.name: colorAlpha
props.description: Hex alpha suffix for the background when `color` is set.

props.name: label
props.description: Label as a prop, for call sites that pass data rather than markup.

props.name: preset
props.description: A named pairing of tone, size and shape used in more than one place.

props.name: tone
props.description: Named colour role. Ignored when `color` is set.

Popover.summary: A panel anchored to whatever opened it, rendered in a portal so no parent's `overflow` can clip it. It owns its open state — pass a `trigger`, not an `open` flag.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the panel lines up with.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance in pixels between trigger and panel.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when it opens or closes.

props.name: position
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it; cloned, so it keeps its own styling.

props.name: triggerClassName
props.description: Placement of the trigger wrapper only.

PriorityBadge.summary: Issue priority as a dot plus its Ukrainian name. The five levels and their colours are fixed here, not configurable: priority is a shared vocabulary.

ProjectSettingsForm.summary: Shared body for «Новий проєкт» and «Налаштування проєкту».

props.name: backlogStatusId
props.description: The status that may never be hidden.

props.name: dangerZone
props.description: Delete-project block; only the settings dialog passes one.

props.name: hiddenStatusIds
props.description: Statuses folded away on the board.

props.name: inviteEmails
props.description: Inline invitations, one email per line, sent with the form.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: the form is saving and its controls are blocked.

props.name: nameError
props.description: Validation message under the name field.

props.name: onHiddenStatusIdsChange
props.description: Fires with the new hidden list.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Opens the full invite dialog. Not used while creating a project.

props.name: onInviteEmailsChange
props.description: Fires with the edited list; its presence is what enables inline invites.

props.name: onTeamMemberIdsChange
props.description: Fires with the new team; the owner is put back if dropped.

props.name: ownerId
props.description: The project's author, who cannot be removed from it.

props.name: teamHint
props.default: 'Ви як автор проєкту будете додані автоматично.'

props.name: teamMembers
props.description: Everybody who could be added to the project.

Segmented.summary: Compact pill switch for mutually exclusive view options (period, week/month).

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected value.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in the order they are drawn.

props.name: surface
props.description: Background: transparent inside a filter bar, canvas when standing alone.

Select.summary: A dropdown. Not a native `<select>`: options carry avatars, colours and glyphs, and the list is rendered in a portal so no pane can clip it.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label sits above.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Unavailable: the trigger is dimmed and will not open.

props.name: filterContext
props.description: Which width scale that lookup uses.

props.name: filterRole
props.description: Which filter this is; `FilterBar` decides the width from it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected value.

props.name: options
props.type: {value: string, label: string, icon?, color?, user?}[]

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text while nothing is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height token, shared with Button and Input.

props.name: variant
props.description: How much chrome the trigger draws.

SelectableChip.summary: A chip you can switch on and off — picking assignees, filtering by label.

props.name: shape
props.description: Which of the two chip geometries to draw.

props.name: tone
props.description: Optional colour role for the `label` shape.

SidebarLayout.summary: The rail-plus-content frame that Settings, Team and Chat all sit in.

props.name: context
props.description: Which frame: who owns the height, and whether a fixed header sits above.

props.name: hasBorder
props.description: Draws the divider between the two panes.

props.name: mobilePane
props.description: Which pane is on screen at mobile width.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: Rail width, where the context allows it to differ.

StatusPill.summary: A workflow status, drawn as the badge-shaped `Pill` in the status's own colour. It exists so no screen has to remember that pairing.

props.name: label
props.description: Status name as the workspace spells it.

StatusVisibilityPicker.summary: Which workflow statuses a board shows and which it folds away.

props.name: backlogStatusId
props.description: The status that may never be hidden.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Unavailable: rows are dimmed and do not respond.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the new hidden list.

Surface.summary: The kit's background block: every grey panel, white card and inset in the product is this component.

props.name: className
props.description: Placement in the parent only — never its own radius, padding or background.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: preset
props.description: Which named surface to draw. Wins over `variant`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy shorthand kept for existing call sites.

Tabs.summary: Horizontal tab strip, 36px tall so it lines up with inputs and buttons in the same row. Arrow keys move between tabs, as the ARIA tab pattern requires.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected tab id.

props.name: tabs
props.type: {id: string, label: string, href?: string, count?: number}[]
props.description: The tabs; `href` turns one into a link.

Tag.summary: A user-created label on a task, with the colour the user picked for it and an optional remove button. `Pill` is the general chip; this is the one that carries a label entity.

props.name: color
props.description: The label's own hex colour; tints background and text.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Renders the × button. Omit for read-only contexts.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Shows the tag glyph before the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Fallback palette used when `color` is not given.

TaskAttributesPanel.summary: The attribute strip at the top of a task or a calendar event: status, dates, assignee, and the "Деталі" drawer for the fields that change less often.

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Placement of the inner card only.

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Inline style for the inner card, for measured widths.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Scrolled state: labels collapse and the rows tighten.

props.name: context
props.description: Which grid the strip uses; the two records carry different fields.

props.name: primaryClassName
props.description: Placement of the primary row only.

props.name: singleRow
props.description: Keeps everything on one row instead of wrapping.

TaskListView.summary: The list view of a board: tasks grouped by status, hidden statuses folded into one «Приховані» group at the end.

props.name: activeTimerIssueId
props.description: The task whose timer is running, if any.

props.name: allIssues
props.description: Every task in scope, for resolving parents and links.

props.name: projectName
props.description: Its name, for the per-row project chip.

props.name: projects
props.description: Projects, needed when the list spans more than one.

props.name: showProjectName
props.description: Whether each row names its project — true only on cross-project lists.

props.name: sprints
props.description: Sprint definitions, for the sprint column.

TaskRow.summary: One task as a row: key, title, type, status, assignee, labels, and the timer dot when it is running.

props.name: allIssues
props.description: Every task in scope, for links that leave the current list.

props.name: issues
props.description: Its siblings, for resolving the parent key.

props.name: isTimerActive
props.description: A timer is running on this task.

props.name: members
props.description: Workspace members, for the assignee avatar.

props.name: showProjectName
props.description: Whether the row names its project — true only on cross-project lists.

TextAction.summary: A borderless text button — the inline Зберегти/Скасувати pair, and quiet links inside rows. A `Button` here would out-weigh the content it sits in.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; needed when the action is icon-only.

props.name: tone
props.description: Which half of the pair this is: affirmative, quiet, or destructive.

Textarea.summary: Multi-line text field. Like `Input`, anything not named here — `value`, `disabled`, `onChange` — reaches the native textarea through the rest spread.

props.name: composition
props.description: Named size contract for a specific place, resolved in globals.css.

props.name: error
props.description: Draws the error border; the message itself belongs to `FormGroup`.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Ceiling for auto-growth, where the caller grows it.

TimeLogRow.summary: One entry in a task's time log: who, how long, when, and what they wrote about it.

props.name: canEdit
props.description: Whether the reader owns this entry.

props.name: description
props.description: What the entry says; omitted rows simply have none.

TimePicker.summary: A time field. The native `type="time"` control with the kit's geometry over it, so the platform keeps the keyboard, the locale and the clock popup.

props.name: error
props.description: Draws the error border and tints the field.

TimeTrackingControl.summary: The timer half of the task attribute strip: a 22px start/stop square and the running total beside it, which doubles as the button that opens the log.

props.name: estimateLabel
props.description: The estimate, already formatted, printed after the total.

props.name: running
props.description: Whether a timer is counting on this task right now.

TitleInput.summary: The page title while it is being edited: heading type, no box, a rule underneath. What an `h1` turns into when you press Редагувати.

Toast.summary: Transient feedback that something happened, floating above the page and closing itself. Anything the reader has to act on is an `Alert`, which stays.

props.name: action
props.description: Label of the single inline action (usually "Скасувати").

props.name: autoClose
props.description: Milliseconds before it closes itself; 0 keeps it until dismissed.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires when it closes, by timer or by the ×.

ToggleSwitch.summary: A switch: it turns something on, immediately, with no save step. Where the change only takes effect on submit, that is a `Checkbox`.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

Tooltip.summary: Tooltip Component A hover tooltip that appears near the trigger element. Displays a small dark tooltip with white text and an arrow pointing to the trigger.

props.name: content
props.description: Text to display in the tooltip

TopHeader.summary: The workspace header: breadcrumbs on the left, presence and notifications on the right.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: The trail for the current screen.

props.name: currentUser
props.description: The signed-in user, for the avatar.

props.name: hideBorder
props.description: Drops the bottom divider where the page draws its own.

props.name: mode
props.description: Which header this is; screens differ in what the right side carries.

props.name: onlineUsers
props.description: Present members, drawn as a stack of avatars.

props.name: onOnlineUserClick
props.description: Fires with the member whose avatar was clicked.

props.name: projectName
props.description: Current project, where the header names one.

props.name: projectSearchActive
props.description: Whether the project search has replaced the trail.

props.name: rightContent
props.description: Extra controls for the right side.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Current query in the header search.

TypeBadge.summary: An issue type (task, bug, story…) with its glyph, drawn as a lighter-tinted `Pill` than `StatusPill` so type never competes with status for attention.

UserAvatar.summary: A person's face, or their initials on a colour derived from their id.

props.name: size
props.description: Named token from the avatar scale; a raw number only where a measured layout needs one.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Adds the white ring that separates overlapping avatars.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows the person's name on hover.

props.name: user
props.description: The person; the photo, the name and the fallback colour all come from this.
